description: Ryan Moffitt is North Carolina through and through. He is a dedicated father to two young sons and raises them in Burlington with his wife, Ashley. A graduate of Elon University and an attorney by trade, he is actively involved in our community, serving as Chairman of the Alamance Chamber of Commerce, a member of the North Carolina Bar Association, and the Alamance Community Foundation.
